report:
**methodology-390 (390px)**
- **Standards table missing columns:** The preview only renders three columns (STANDARD, PURITY, QUANTITY). The design shows all five columns (including LABELING and SOMETIMES) visible in the mobile viewport; the missing data must be accessible via horizontal scroll or reflow.
- **Labeling Score Calculated left-column background:** The points list (2 points / 1 point / 0 points) sits on a white background in the preview. The design shows the entire left subsection (points list plus methodology note) wrapped in a continuous light-gray background container.
- **Methodology note accent border:** The preview shows a green left border on the note box. The design shows a plain light-gray box with no colored left border.
- **Hero heading size/weight:** The “Methodology” title appears slightly smaller and/or lighter in the preview compared with the design.

**methodology-744 (744px)**
- **Formula card line wrapping:** The NATURAL RATING and POSTERIOR MEAN formulas wrap to extra lines in the preview; the design keeps them on fewer lines within the card.
- **Labeling Score Calculated left-column background:** Same as mobile—the points list lacks the continuous light-gray background container shown in the design.
- **Methodology note green border:** Same as mobile—the note box has a green left border that is absent in the design.
- **Standards table row height:** Preview table cells have slightly more vertical padding, producing taller rows than the compact design.

**methodology-1440 (1440px)**
- **Formula typography wrapping:** NATURAL RATING, POSTERIOR MEAN, and EVIDENCE PRIOR DECAY formulas break across more lines in the preview. The design renders them more compactly.
- **Labeling Score Calculated left-column background:** The points list and note should share a continuous light-gray background box; the preview applies the background only to the note.
- **Methodology note border:** The preview adds a green left accent border that is not present in the design.
- **Standards table column proportions:** The preview distributes column widths roughly evenly. The design gives LABELING more width and SOMETIMES less width to match content.
- **Hero heading:** The “Methodology” title is slightly smaller or less bold in the preview than in the design.
